description: Your team spots something in the chart, and you hear about it as a screenshot pasted into PowerPoint or through a complex workaround. The number lives in Power BI. The explanation lives in somebody's inbox. Zebra BI Charts+ brings Power BI commenting to the people who read your reports. It is an additional visual, built on the capabilities of Zebra BI Charts. One thing is added: analysts, controllers, and executives comment directly on a data point, in view mode, with no Power BI edit access. • Power BI commenting in view mode. Viewers add context on the exact data point, no edit rights required. • Comments stay in your Microsoft 365. Stored in a SharePoint Excel file you own. Zebra BI stores and processes nothing. • Governance stays separate. Power BI permissions decide who sees the report, SharePoint permissions decide who comments. • The charts business reporting runs on. Waterfall chart, variance, small multiples, line, column, area, dot, lollipop, and combo, in one visual. • Every chart type built to the IBCS standard. Consistent scaling, colors, and variance conventions across every report. • Automatic variance calculations. Against PY, Plan, and Forecast, with no manual setup. • Chart slider and responsive layouts. One report serves analyst and executive. • Annotations that follow your filters. The annotations layer stays in step with slicers. Not the longest list of…
